post.body:
Have you heard the latest buzz in downtown Loveland? There’s a new kid on the block that’s quickly becoming a must-visit destination for locals and visitors alike – Sage Speakeasy. Right  Loveland, this underrated pick is creating quite the stir, and it’s easy to see why!

What’s a Speakeasy, Anyway?

If you’re not familiar with the concept, let’s take a little trip down memory lane. The term “speakeasy” dates back to the Prohibition era of the 1920s and early 1930s in the United States. Back then, alcohol was outlawed, and people had to get creative about where they could enjoy a drink. Enter the speakeasy – secret bars that often required a password for entry or were cleverly concealed behind unmarked doors. They offered an air of mystery and a place to escape the daily grind.

Fast forward to today, and while we no longer have to hide our cocktail sippin’, the allure of the speakeasy remains. Modern speakeasies, like Sage, capture that nostalgic vibe, providing an intimate setting where you can relax, unwind, and enjoy your drink in a unique and memorable environment.

A Dream Come True in Downtown Loveland

Back when I lived in Loveland, I had a vision for the downtown area – a vibrant, bustling space filled with unique spots where the community could gather and connect. I was so inspired by this vision that I even went door to door, dreaming of opening my own speakeasy. While that dream didn’t quite come to fruition then, seeing places like Sage come to life now fills me with so much joy!

Sage Speakeasy isn’t just your typical bar. It’s a thoughtfully designed space that exudes charm and comfort. When you step inside, you’re immediately greeted by a warm, inviting atmosphere that encourages you to slow down, put your phone away, and truly savor the moment. Every detail, from the meticulously curated drink menu to the cozy seating arrangements, has been crafted to create a one-of-a-kind experience.

On my recent visit, I indulged in a mezcal cocktail with artichoke liquor, topped with a brûlée marshmallow. Trust me when I say, it was an absolute treat for the senses! Sage is a place where you can lose track of time, enjoying good company and even better drinks.

The Heart of Loveland is Thriving!

Right now, downtown Loveland is the place to be! It’s more than just the incredible drinks at Sage or the cozy ambiance – it’s about community. Loveland’s downtown area has blossomed into a lively hub filled with unique shops, art galleries, and delicious eateries. It’s a place where everyone feels welcome, and there’s always something exciting happening.

One of the best things about Loveland is its fantastic location. Just a short drive from other Colorado favorites like Denver, Estes Park, Boulder, and Fort Collins, Loveland offers the perfect blend of small-town charm and easy access to the big city or mountain adventures.

Thinking About Making Loveland Your Home?

If you’ve been considering a move to Loveland, now is a great time to dive in and explore all that this vibrant town has to offer. From the quaint downtown area to scenic views and friendly neighborhoods, Loveland truly has something for everyone.
